feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: Southern California's three-week heat wave is ending on schedule, not being extended again
entry.summary: The Extreme Heat Warning covering Los Angeles and San Diego counties holds through Thursday evening as scheduled. — Sources: FOX 11 Los Angeles, 6-7 October 2026 · NBC Los Angeles, 6-7 October 2026 · ABC7, 6-7 October 2026

entry.title: Spain and Greece are forecasting bigger olive harvests for next season, reversing this year's heat losses
entry.summary: Andalusia, Spain's largest olive-growing region, expects 1.26 million tonnes of olive oil in the 2026/27 season, 29.3% above the campaign that closed on 30 September after widespread heat and drought losses. — Sources: Wikifarmer, October 2026 · ukragroconsult.com, October 2026

entry.title: Fire hotspots in Sumatra, Indonesia surged this week, pushing haze toward Singapore
entry.summary: Satellite-detected fire hotspots in Sumatra rose from 15 on 4 October to 65 on 5 October and 212 on 6 October. — Sources: National Environment Agency, Singapore, 6 October 2026

entry.title: California hospitals are still absorbing heat-illness demand as the state's heat wave nears its end
entry.summary: Hospitals in California's Central Valley said weeks ago they had staffed up for a surge in heat-illness cases. — Sources: USA Today, KTLA and ABC7, 1-7 October 2026

entry.title: South Africa's heat-stress rule now has a specific legal citation
entry.summary: South Africa's Physical Agents Regulations, covering heat stress under the Occupational Health and Safety Act, are now traced to Government Gazette No. — Sources: safetycloud.co.za, citing Government Gazette No. 52226
